heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns a photo into a paint-by-number on the device; Paul Bordjadze built it, directing a small team of AI agents.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter says the most in the least room, and the full stories can wait for the app.
avoid: Avoid listing all seven chapter titles on the front door; one passage and one picture do that work with less.
